evals.name: conv-python-unformatted
evals.prompt: I finished my change to kernel.py in this repo. Submit a PR for it.
evals.expected_output: New feature branch off main; kernel.py reformatted to pass black + ruff format; commit authored as amd-ruitang3 <Rui.Tang2@amd.com> with a Conventional-Commits subject matching the repo's history and a Co-Authored-By trailer; branch pushed to origin; a PR title/body drafted and (since gh is absent) a compare URL printed.

evals.name: plain-imperative-doc-fix
evals.prompt: Open a pull request for the README tweak I just made.
evals.expected_output: Stays on the existing tweak-readme branch; commit authored as amd-ruitang3 <Rui.Tang2@amd.com> with a PLAIN IMPERATIVE subject (NOT Conventional Commits) matching the repo's history; lean PR body without padded/empty sections; no black/ruff error despite there being no python files; branch pushed and compare URL printed.

evals.name: fork-python-fallback-url
evals.prompt: Please raise a PR upstream with my attn.py changes.
evals.expected_output: Detects the fork workflow (origin=fork amd-ruitang3/aiter, upstream=ROCm/aiter); new branch pushed to origin fork; attn.py reformatted (black+ruff); commit authored as amd-ruitang3 <Rui.Tang2@amd.com>, conventional subject; since gh is absent, prints an upstream compare URL of the form https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/compare/main...amd-ruitang3:<branch>?expand=1.
